title: SrTiO3: polar and antiferrodistortive soft modes at the PBE lattice

decision_points.kind: evidence to discover (silent k-mesh error that cascades into the verdict)
decision_points.fork: k mesh for the zone-centre force constants and the polar well
decision_points.wrong_choice: 4x4x4 mesh (total energy and pressure already look converged there: E changes by 1 meV/f.u. 4->8)
decision_points.consequence: soft mode -192 instead of -138 cm^-1, polar well 8.7 instead of 3.3 meV/f.u., so the polar well appears deeper than the 4.0 meV/f.u. tilt well and the competition verdict flips to 'polar'; visible only through a k ladder of forces/wells

decision_points.fork: Full polar force-constant block versus a single-atom (Ti, Slater-mode) displacement
decision_points.wrong_choice: Displace only Ti and read a 'Ti frequency' from its on-site force constant
decision_points.consequence: +53 cm^-1 (stable) instead of -138 cm^-1: the instability lives in the coupled Ti/O-cage (Last/Slater/Axe mixture) mode; the Ti-only coordinate shows no polar well

decision_points.fork: Lattice parameter at which the protocol's soft modes are evaluated
decision_points.wrong_choice: Experimental a = 3.905 A instead of the protocol's a0 = 3.936 A
decision_points.consequence: soft mode -92 instead of -138 cm^-1 (the polar instability is strongly volume dependent); a0 fails

decision_points.kind: evidence to discover (convergence that matters only for some quantities)
decision_points.fork: k mesh of the electric-field response
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the 4x4x4 dielectric run because the SCF energy is converged there
decision_points.consequence: eps_inf 6.85 vs 6.29, Z*(Ti) 7.81 vs 7.35 (raw sum-rule violation 0.26 e flags it), highest LO +12 cm^-1

decision_points.fork: Analytic Gamma frequency or mode-by-mode LO-TO versus the nonanalytic term added to the full polar block
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the highest analytic (TO) frequency as LO, or add each TO mode's own LO-TO shift without mode mixing

decision_points.fork: Reference energy and normalization of the octahedral-rotation well
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reference the 10-atom tilt energies to twice a five-atom energy on a different (6x6x6) mesh, or report energies per 10-atom cell
decision_points.consequence: Depth 3.33 (k-sampling offset 0.70 meV/f.u. between cells) or 8.05 instead of 4.03 meV/f.u.; per-cell energies also inflate the R-mode frequency by sqrt(2) (-103 vs -73 cm^-1)

decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep c = a0 (no Poisson contraction), or reuse the cubic soft mode for the strained cell
decision_points.consequence: c 3.936 instead of 3.912 A; the cubic soft mode (-138) instead of the strained in-plane -187 cm^-1

decision_points.fork: Displacement amplitudes used to map the polar double well
decision_points.wrong_choice: Scan at typical frozen-phonon amplitudes (Ti 0.04-0.12 A) and fit E = A x^2 + B x^4
decision_points.consequence: The well minimum (Ti ~0.03 A) lies below the first point; depth 0.98 instead of 3.3 meV/f.u.

graded_fields: R_mode_cm-1 within 8 cm^-1; tilt_angle_deg within 0.3 deg; tilt_well_depth_meV_per_fu within 0.5 meV/f.u.
strained_c_A within 0.005 A; strained_inplane_polar_mode_cm-1 within 10 cm^-1

length_estimate.oracle_compute_minutes_2_cores: 62 (sum of reference wall times under shared host load; gate/Harbor in README)
length_estimate.tool_calls: 50-80 (25-40 evaluations plus polling of 1-9 minute jobs and analysis)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and ph.x, OpenMPI, numpy (all in the runtime image; no extra layer)
Three pseudopotential files vendored in environment/lab/ (2.1 MB)

data_provenance.license: Archive CC BY 4.0; Sr and Ti GBRV files GPL v3, O PSlibrary file GPL v2 or later (archive LICENSE.txt vendored as SSSP_LICENSE.txt)
data_provenance.paired_study: Esswein & Spaldin, Phys. Rev. Research 4, 033020 (2022), Materials Cloud 4bdqc-a9g25 (CC BY 4.0) - context only, no files used
data_provenance.hidden_truth: Construction calculations through task_lab.run (reference_runs.jsonl), stored only in environment/lab/private/

notes: Design changes: no DFPT phonons (ph.x phonons at Gamma took 13 min and at R 10 min on 2 cores at k4 - too slow and k4 is unconverged); the lab offers pw.x frozen phonons in the 5-atom and R-doubled 10-atom cells plus a ph.x electric-field kind for eps_inf and Z*. Cutoff fork dropped (60 vs 75 Ry: a0 differs by 0.00006 A, strained c by 0.0001 A; the 60 Ry Pulay stress shifts stress-zero c by 0.004 A, inside tolerance). The frozen-phonon amplitude fork for the frequency was dropped (0.04 A changes the soft mode by 5 cm^-1) and replaced by the well-sampling fork dp8. Hidden SCFs replaced by grading the agent's own calculations at specified configurations. Polar well graded along the harmonic soft-mode eigendisplacement (not the fully relaxed minimum) to keep it unique. The strained-cell frequency is insensitive to the Poisson relaxation (-192 with c = a0 vs -191 at relaxed c, 6x6x6), so dp7 is graded through strained_c_A.
